scope: all FW2 performance-eligible neural configurations, with paired frozen performance-only and audit-guided rule reporting
outer_access_authorization: permitted only after this plan, the private manifest, and its tracked hash definition are frozen
refit_unit: outer domain by eligible configuration by seed

training_contract.training_pool: all non-outer subjects, including frozen stress-only training subjects
training_contract.fit_calibration_split: deterministic label-stratified 85/15 split of the non-outer training pool separately for each frozen seed
training_contract.graph_construction: fit only on model-fit rows for graph families
training_contract.early_stopping: the frozen calibration subset; outer rows forbidden
training_contract.calibration: Platt scaling fit on the same non-outer calibration subset after checkpoint selection

seed_aggregation.prediction: arithmetic mean of the five calibrated outer probabilities for each subject and configuration
seed_aggregation.metrics: computed once from the seed-mean subject probabilities

selection_lock.performance_only: exactly the seven selections frozen by FW2
selection_lock.audit_guided: exactly the seven selections frozen by FW4

endpoint_execution.E1: paired equal-domain macro AUROC difference, audit-guided minus performance-only
endpoint_execution.E2: paired pooled out-of-domain discrimination, threshold, Brier, calibration, and ECE metrics
endpoint_execution.P3: repeat rule-level equal-domain macro summaries on the five stable domains frozen before outcomes
endpoint_execution.E3: inner-only named profile rows for configurations within 0.02 of the best inner macro AUROC in each outer loop
endpoint_execution.E4: Spearman and standardized HC3 association between penultimate linear full-sample selectivity and valid random-corrected use
endpoint_execution.E5: Spearman and standardized HC3 association between joint-use inner-domain variance and outer AUROC loss, adjusted for inner AUROC, calibration distance, and log parameter count when at least 10 complete rows exist
endpoint_execution.E6: continuous acquisition decodability/use associations with outer AUROC loss; nonvarying or fewer-than-10 components are explicitly not estimable
endpoint_execution.E7: descriptive evidence-based taxonomy using only rules frozen here and previously frozen inner evidence

uncertainty.E1: resample domains with replacement, then subjects stratified by label within each sampled domain; both rules share every resample
uncertainty.E2: paired subject resampling stratified jointly by outer domain and label

taxonomy.audit_invalid: one or more invalid J_C006/C_C007 inner-domain conditions
taxonomy.acquisition_reliance: one or more frozen validated S001/S002/S003 acquisition-use violations
taxonomy.calibration_only_drift: outer AUROC loss is at most 0.02 and outer Brier exceeds the inner-domain macro Brier
taxonomy.prevalence_composition_sensitivity: absolute outer versus non-outer prevalence difference is at least 0.05 and outer AUROC loss exceeds 0.02
taxonomy.unexplained_residual_failure: outer AUROC loss exceeds 0.02 without a prior assigned evidence category
taxonomy.no_material_failure: outer AUROC loss is at most 0.02 without calibration-only drift
taxonomy.disease_evidence_loss: not assigned without a separate outer-domain validated-use intervention; never inferred from performance alone
taxonomy.acquisition_encoding: retained as continuous E6 evidence; no post-outcome high/low threshold is introduced

privacy: outer predictions, metrics, configuration identifiers, endpoint estimates, and taxonomy rows remain under outputs/private; tracked logs contain counts, checks, and hashes only
